meta.requirement: Explore Stormbearer Mountains (5%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: William's Valberries
start.text:
''You hear him before you see him.''

''Not a cry for help. More like someone trying very hard not to make one. A sharp intake of breath, then a muttered word you cannot quite catch, followed by the sound of a pack being dragged across gravel.''

''Around the bend, a young man sits on a flat stone beside the trail, one boot off, sock darkening at the ankle. A wicker basket lies overturned beside him, three bruised Valberries rolling in the dust.''

William: ''looking up, forcing a smile'' Oh. Good. A person. I was starting to think the mountain only sent slimes up here.

uaight.text:
William: ''wincing as he shifts his weight'' Define all right. I can still talk. That counts.

''He gestures at the overturned basket with his chin.''

William: My sister Elise is getting married next week. She asked for a Valberry cake. Not store-bought. ''beat'' She was very specific about that part.

''He prods the ankle gently and his face tightens.''

William: I came up yesterday to gather berries. Found a few. Then I stepped wrong on a wet stone about an hour ago and the mountain decided I had done enough walking for one day.

''He looks at the three berries in the dust, then away.''

William: I still need ten. The recipe does not forgive shortcuts.

choices.label: I can gather them for you

Ten_valberry.text:
William: Ten, yes. Firm. ''holds up one finger, then another, then stops and puts his hand down'' The baker I work for says anything less and the filling turns thin. Elise would notice. She notices everything.

''He glances at the scrub along the ridgeline, where red berries glint between the rocks in scattered clusters.''

William: They grow all along this slope if you know where to look. I had mapped half of them before my foot decided otherwise. ''looks at you'' You look like someone who explores. Could you finish what I started?

choices.label: Ten Valberry. I'll bring them back

bringus10val.text:
William: ''some of the tension leaves his shoulders''

William: Thank you. Truly. I'll stay right here and sort what I already have. ''taps the basket'' Just bring them back to this stone when you've got the full ten.

''He settles back against the rock, ankle elevated on the pack, and watches the trail with the expression of a man who has run out of other options.''

William: And try not to step on the wet ones. I can confirm from experience that they do not improve.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Collect 10 Valberry and return to William at Stormbearer Mountains

continues.label: Do /rpg and click on Return to William

gotleberry.text:
''William is exactly where you left him, ankle still propped on the pack. He has recovered the three berries from the dust and lined them up on a cloth like evidence in a trial.''

William: ''looking up quickly'' You're back. ''trying not to sound too hopeful'' Did you find them?

notyet.text:
William: ''nods, reasonable about it''

William: No rush. Well. ''glances at the sky'' Some rush. The berries bruise if you wait too long to sort them, and my ankle is not getting better on its own.

''He rearranges the three berries on the cloth with unnecessary care.''

William: I'll be here.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Collect 10 Valberry and return to William at Stormbearer Mountains

here10.text:
William: ''takes the berries one at a time, checking each for bruising before setting it on the cloth''

William: ...Ten. Perfect. ''exhales'' Elise is going to ask where I found these and I am going to have to lie creatively about my heroic mountaineering.

''He works quickly despite the ankle, sorting the best berries into the basket and lining the rest with wax paper from his pack. His hands know the routine.''

will_u_make_desc.text:
''William finishes tying the basket closed and sits back. For a moment he just looks at it.''

William: ...Honestly? Not tonight. ''taps his ankle'' This needs to stay elevated, and the trail down is worse than the trail up. I know because I tried twice already.

''He lifts the basket and holds it out.''

William: But these will not keep until morning. Valberry spoils fast once picked. Elise lives in Mondstadt, near the south gate. Blue shutters, white door. She'll know what the basket is the moment she sees it.

''He meets your eyes.''

William: I know I have already asked enough. But could you carry this down for me?

choices.label: Blue shutters, white door. Got it

I_will_take_it_to_her.text:
William: ''places the basket carefully in your hands''

William: Tell her I twisted my ankle and not my priorities. ''almost smiles'' And tell her the cake will still happen. I'll be down by tomorrow if I have to crawl.

''He settles back against the stone, basket gone, looking lighter than he has all day.''

William: Thank you, traveller. For all of it.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Deliver William's berry basket to Elise in Mondstadt City

continues.label: Go to Mondstadt City (Mondstadt), do /rpg and then click on Deliver the Berry Basket to Elise

tomond.text:
''The house is easy to find. Blue shutters, white door, exactly as described. You knock, and after a moment it opens.''

''A young woman in a flour-dusted apron stands in the doorway, dark hair pinned up for baking. Her eyes go straight to the basket.''

Elise: ''quietly'' He actually found them.

''She takes the basket with both hands, checking the berries through the weave with a practiced eye.''

Elise: These are perfect. Where is he?

choices.label: Still on the mountain. Twisted ankle

verries_delivered.title: Berries Delivered
verries_delivered.text:
Elise: ''closes her eyes briefly'' Of course he is. ''opens them, fond and exasperated in equal measure'' He went up there alone with a wicker basket and no backup plan. I told him the market in Mondstadt sells Valberry.

''She sets the basket on a side table and returns with a folded note.''

Elise: He left this at the guild counter for whoever helped him. He said it wouldn't be enough. He's probably right. But it's what he set aside, and he'd sulk if you didn't take it.

''She looks back at the berries, already planning the recipe in her head.''

Elise: Tell him the cake will be ready for the rehearsal dinner. And tell him to come down the trail carefully. ''beat'' I mean it.
